data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year net technical result, deficit of GBP 2.2m on direct business (2020: surplus of GBP 1.0m) and deficit of GBP 42.6m on reinsurance accepted business (2020: surplus of GBP 2.5m) relate to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

prior_year_events.impact_description: material uncertainty arising from a potential accumulation of claims in respect of a single policyholder. The claims in question are very complex, due to uncertainty over coverage, liability and the quantum of the claims. The best estimate reserves is intended to strike a balance between favourable and adverse outcomes, but the ultimate cost of the claims could be materially higher or lower than this best estimate.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1110 experienced a GBP 44.8 million strengthening in prior year reserves for 2021, representing 21.70% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by a GBP 42.6 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business and a GBP 2.2 million deficit on direct business, both relating to reassessments of net claims incurred for previous accident years. The significant deficit in reinsurance accepted business is attributed to material uncertainty from a complex accumulation of claims from a single policyholder in the 2019 year of account, involving uncertainties over coverage, liability, and quantum.
